text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MC-003","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N8","page":1,"quote":"M30 x 1.5 x 25 DEEP MAJOR DIA-0.1"}],"comment":"Note N8 specifies an M30 thread 25 mm deep but the drawing shows no thread run-out or undercut at the bottom of the hole, which is required when a thread meets a shoulder or blind bottom. Without it the tap cannot produce full-form threads to the specified depth and assembly may be compromised; the designer should add a thread relief groove or specify adequate run-out length beyond the 25 mm engagement.","recommended_correction":"Add a thread undercut or explicitly call out thread run-out past the 25 mm depth for the M30 x 1.5 thread in N8."},{"rule_id":"MC-009","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"title","page":1,"quote":"SHAFT"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"⌀82"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀40"}],"comment":"The title block identifies the part as a SHAFT with multiple turned diameters (D11 ⌀82, D12 ⌀40), yet no centre holes are specified anywhere on the drawing. Centre holes are needed to support the shaft between centres during turning to maintain concentricity across the stepped diameters; the designer should add centre hole specifications at both ends of the shaft.","recommended_correction":"Specify centre holes (e.g., per ISO 6411) on both ends of the shaft to allow turning between centres."}]}
